description: Measures finite singles counts and rates across logical analyzer states for one or more analyzer-equipped target links. network.json declares each channel as polarizer or PBS: complementary PBS outputs are acquired together, reducing physical settings without changing the reported logical states. An explicit latchGuard policy is applied to every acquired window; required includes the network-resolved detector-health devices in the declared resource union.

targetLinkIds.description: Analyzer-equipped target quantum-link identifiers measured at each state.

polarizationAnalyzerDeviceIds.description: Analyzer devices leased while their target channels are configured and scanned.

tomographyStates.description: Logical H/V/D/A/R/L projections to report. A PBS acquires complementary pairs from one physical H/D/R setting; a polarizer requires one setting per requested logical projection.

items.description: One analyzer state accepted by the polarization analyzer.

measurementDurationSec.description: Finite singles acquisition duration for each analyzer state, in seconds.

settleSec.description: Non-blocking delay after each analyzer-state change and before its finite measurement window, in seconds. The default allows the polarization analyzer to settle physically.

clear.description: Whether every finite acquisition window starts from cleared measurements.

useCompensatedTomoStates.description: Whether named analyzer states are resolved from an installed or loaded compensation table instead of the factory tomography table.

dwdmChannelByLink.description: Optional per-target DWDM channel overrides for analyzer wavelength configuration.

defaultDwdmChannel.description: Optional fallback DWDM channel when a target link does not declare one in network.json.

finalTomographyState.description: Optional state applied to every target analyzer after the scan, including best-effort terminal cleanup after a failed or aborted scan.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window latch policy propagated to background and tomography acquisitions. required rejects invalid windows and retries only after detector recovery; disabled deliberately acquires without latch protection.

mode.description: Whether per-window detector-latch validation is disabled or required.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries of an invalid window after a recovered latch.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact scan lease union: resolved analyzers and TimeTagger, plus every network-resolved health guard when required.

items.description: One device needed by this acquisition or scan.

link.characterization.observation.linkPo.description: Singles counts and rates indexed by target link and analyzer state, with resolved topology and acquisition provenance.
